verdict.rationale: Stripe documents sandboxes for testing functionality without affecting the live integration. This is genuine environment isolation, not just a dry-run. Terminal adds a built-in simulated card reader, so integrations can be tested without physical hardware or real transactions. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use, explicit documentation of AI agents (MCP/CLI) operating against the sandbox, detail on how sandbox data stays isolated from production

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: You can use your sandbox to test Stripe functionality in your account, and experiment with new features without affecting your live integration.
Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integration come with a built-in simulated card reader, so you can develop and test your app without connecting to physical hardware.
Before ordering a reader, test your integration with the reader simulator.
